rationale: Parity is correct (<1e-17 max_abs_diff) with canonical refGeom.expt (det(U)=1.000565, within 0.06% of unity). However, A_scale_only convergence test catastrophically failed: χ² exploded 1257× (from 1.13M to 1.43B) and median ROI CC collapsed from 1.0 to -0.045 after 10 Adam steps. This reproduces PARITY-002 Phase C2 failure exactly, proving the problem is NOT file-specific. Root cause is convergence pathology (optimizer/loss/gradient), not geometry encoding parity.
